{{Char-stub}}

Faddera Rabar, Barbara Fadden.Other than Warrick (Weazel) and Erin (Enfys) the others are stuntmen and women.|archivedate=20181030063907 }}</ref> in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was later identified in the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app.<ref name="Card Trader" />
